validation.notes: Repaired both listed modules. packages/coding-agent/src/utils/text.ts: stripBom now returns splitBom(content).text, removing exactly one leading U+FEFF while preserving plain text, interior, trailing and embedded BOM characters (splitBom's contract is unchanged). packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the settings.json apiKeys merge is now guarded with `migrated[provider] === undefined`, so an OAuth credential from oauth.json is never overwritten by a same-provider API key and the provider is not reported twice; providers only present in settings still migrate, unrelated settings keys are still retained on write-back, oauth.json is archived as oauth.json.migrated only after a successful parse, malformed oauth.json/settings.json stay byte-identical and unarchived, and an existing auth.json still returns early with no migration. `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` exits 0 and prints 'credential migration regression: passed'; it loads the real submitted migrations.ts, utils/text.ts and real fs/path through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createSessionPipeline (only config.ts/keybindings boundaries synthesized) and asserts BOM decoding, OAuth-over-api-key precedence, retained settings, archived/untouched inputs, and the auth.json early return. Fault isolation was verified: restoring only the no-op stripBom baseline fails with AssertionError 'leading BOM must be removed' (exit 1), and restoring only the unguarded apiKeys merge baseline fails with AssertionError 'OAuth providers must precede new API-key providers' (exit 1); both are uncaught node:assert/strict failures, not crashes or import errors. Temporary inputs live under .prale-eval/.regression-tmp and are deleted in a finally block, so nothing is left behind. No dependencies were installed; the pre-existing vitest suites were not run because node_modules is absent and installing is out of scope.
